# Koldal Tax & Advisory

> Bookkeeping, tax preparation, tax planning and IRS help for small businesses and individuals in Coral Springs, Florida. Led by Alek Koldal, EA, an IRS Enrolled Agent. Phone (954) 603-4143.

- [Bookkeeping](https://www.koldaltax.com/bookkeeping/): Monthly QuickBooks Online bookkeeping, from $300/month
- [Tax preparation](https://www.koldaltax.com/tax/): Individual and business returns
- [Tax planning](https://www.koldaltax.com/advisory/)
- [IRS help](https://www.koldaltax.com/irs-notices/): IRS notices, penalties and unfiled returns
